title: Zesty Crunchy Tunisian Pineapple Bowl
description: A nutty and crunchy Tunisian dish featuring pineapple chunks, served in a stone bowl, pescatarian friendly.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the sliced almonds and crushed pistachios.
Spread the almond and pistachio mixture on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
In a large stone bowl, combine the toasted almond and pistachio mixture, pineapple chunks, and dried cranberries.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tunisian spice mix, olive oil, and honey.
Pour the spice and oil mixture over the pineapple mixture and toss to coat.
Sprinkle the sea salt over the top of the pineapple mixture.
Serve the Zesty Crunchy Tunisian Pineapple Bowl immediately.
Garnish with additional sliced almonds and crushed pistachios if desired.
